title: Our First Flight
雏鹰展翅
description: Witness a young hawk's first flight.
见证小鹰的初次飞行

title: Wild Animals
前兽出没
description: Drive off a beast of the moor together with your young hawk.
和小鹰一起击退荒原的野兽

title: Dances with Fox
与狐共舞
description: Witness a friendship across species.
见证一段跨物种友谊

title: Hooves on the Wind
踏风逐野
description: Reach the final stage of the horse transformation.
首次完成马转化。

title: Whale of the Wide Blue
鲸跃沧溟
description: Reach the final stage of the whale transformation.
首次完成鲸转化。

title: Night on Black Wings
玄翎渡夜
description: Complete your raven transformation for the first time.
首次完成鸦转化。

title: Cursed Flesh
诅咒之躯
description: Become undead for the first time through the cursed coins.
因诅咒金币而首次变为亡灵。

title: Back Among the Living
复归常人
description: Return every cursed coin and lift the undead curse.
归还全部诅咒金币，解除亡灵诅咒。

title: Who Says Robin Can't Balance the Books?
谁说罗宾不会算账
description: Help Robin settle their debt and pay their own rent.
帮罗宾结清旧债，并开始承担自己的房租。

title: This Week's on Me
这周我来付
description: Agree with Robin to face the rent together.
与罗宾约好共同面对房租。

title: Bailey, We're Square
贝利，账清了
description: Stand with Robin and the other orphans until Bailey gives up collecting your rent.
与罗宾及其他孤儿站在一起，直到贝利放弃向你们收租。

title: Honeyhole Ice City
蜜雪冰城
description: Open a shop on Cliff Street with Robin.
与罗宾一起在峭壁街开店。

title: Beyond Restraint
挣脱极限
description: Reach the new physique cap after breaking its limit.
将体格提升至突破后的新上限。

title: Master of All
全能
description: Raised willpower, physique, beauty, promiscuity, exhibitionism and deviancy to their limits beyond the original maximum.
令意志、体能、容貌、淫乱、暴露癖与异种癖全部达到突破后的极限。

title: Thanks Won't Come Out
谢字说不出口
description: Rescue Whitney from the underground brothel and escape together.
从地下妓院救出惠特尼，并一起逃离。

title: Evidence Matters
言之有据
description: Record the lake artefact’s discovery site and distinguish evidence from conjecture throughout your research, draft and final presentation.
记录湖底文物的发现位置，并在历史项目的研究、草稿与答辩中始终区分证据与推测。

title: History Exhibition Winner
历史展览冠军
description: Win the local history exhibition with a fully supported conclusion.
以完整的考证赢得本地历史展览。

title: Poolside Rendezvous
泳池之约
description: Bring all four love interests to a school pool party.
带着全部四位恋人参加一次校园泳池派对。

title: Student Council President
学生会长
description: Accept Leighton's appointment to lead the student council.
接受礼顿的任命，主持学生会。

title: Naked School
全裸校园
description: Make mandatory nudity a permanent school dress policy after its trial.
让强制裸体的着装规范通过试行，正式成为校规。

title: On a Roll
手气正旺
description: Make a net profit on five consecutive casino hands in one night. A tie or loss breaks the streak.
一晚在赌馆牌桌连续五局净赢。平局或输局中断连胜。

title: A Good Night
满载而归
description: Reach a net casino profit of £10,000 in one night.
一晚在赌馆累计净赢达到 £10,000。

title: Steady Hands
稳坐牌桌
description: Handle ten table disputes correctly while working as a dealer.
正确处理十次荷官工作中的牌桌争议。

title: Giant Killer
以小搏大
description: In three-card poker, beat three cards of the same rank with a 2, 3 and 5 that are not all the same suit, then collect the winnings.
在炸金花中，用非同花的2、3、5击败三张同点数的牌，再领取奖金。

title: Too Many Stops Tonight
今夜忙不过来
description: Follow the Halloween route through Robin, Whitney, Kylar and Sydney.
同一个万圣夜，先后陪伴罗宾、惠特尼、凯拉尔与悉尼。

title: Beauty Beyond Compare
倾国倾城
description: Reach the new beauty cap after breaking its limit.
将美貌提升至突破后的新上限。

title: Beyond the Mirror
镜子的另一边
description: Cross the tentacle plains and leave through a different discovered mirror.
穿过触手平原，从另一处已发现的镜子离开。

title: Forbidden Rite
禁忌仪式
description: Reach the new deviancy cap after breaking its limit.
将异种癖提升至突破后的新上限。

title: Before Every Eye
众目之下
description: Reach the new exhibitionism cap after breaking its limit.
将暴露癖提升至突破后的新上限。

title: Pleasure in Every Inch
寸寸皆欢
description: Reach the new promiscuity cap after breaking its limit.
将淫乱提升至突破后的新上限。

title: From Branch to Counter
从枝头到柜台
description: Harvest lemons or oranges from your own orchard, then fulfil an order for the same fruit at Robin's drinks shop.
采收过自行种植的柠檬或橙子，并完成相应品种的一笔罗宾饮品店供货订单。

title: A Seat at the Table
席间有我
description: Be formally appointed to the board of Avery's company for the first time.
首次正式获任艾弗里公司的董事席位。

title: In Control
控局
description: Hold more than 50% of Avery's company in settled shares.
持有艾弗里公司超过50%的已交割股份。

title: Night Raven
夜渡鸦
description: Complete the ascension ceremony alongside Avery as the fourth seat and receive the name Night Raven.
以第四席的身份，与艾弗里共同完成升华仪式，并获称夜渡鸦。

title: Open for Business
开工大吉
description: Produce and deliver your first factory order, then receive payment. Advances do not count.
完成首笔工厂订单的生产与交货，并收到账款。预付款不计入。

title: Flying Without a Net
空中飞人
description: Have a losing leveraged position forcibly liquidated for the first time. Voluntary closes, stop-loss orders and expiry settlements do not count.
首次因亏损触发杠杆仓位强制平仓。主动平仓、止损和到期结算不计入。

title: Back on My Feet
东山再起
description: After a forced liquidation leaves collection debt, repay it in full and recover the entire loss, including fees, through subsequent net trading profits.
杠杆强平留下追偿债务后，实际还清欠款，再以此后的交易净收益赚回这次包含费用的全部损失。

title: Where's My Money?
货到了，钱呢？
description: Deliver a factory order only for the customer to default on payment.
工厂订单已经交货，客户却在结算时拒付货款。

title: A Key of Your Own
一把自己的钥匙
description: Buy your first home.
首次购入一处自住房。

title: Feels Like Home
终于像个家
description: Furnish one home with a bed, wardrobe, table, chair and decoration, plus a desk if it has a study.
为同一处自住房配齐床、衣柜、桌子、椅子和饰品。有书房的住宅还需配备书桌。

title: Leave a Light On
留一盏灯
description: Spend time together at home with a lover who has moved in.
与正式入住自住房的恋人完成一次日常陪伴。

title: Ride the Wind
顺风而行
description: Glide from your home and land on a different street.
从自住房高处滑翔，落到另一条街道。

title: Flesh of Your Own
身为己有
description: Reach the new willpower cap after breaking its limit.
将意志提升至突破后的新上限。

title: Quiet as a Mouse
悄然无声
description: Complete a quiet bank heist and receive your share without raising the alarm or being identified.
完成一次安静的银行豪劫并实际分到账款，全程没有触发警报或被认出。

title: In the Net
收网
description: Complete your first verified police bounty handover and receive payment.
首次完成警方悬赏的核实与移交，并领取报酬。

title: First Across
先到一步
description: Finish every section of an open-class road race and take first place.
完整跑完公路赛进阶组的全部赛段，并取得第一名。
